title: Tow Rates by Agency Search Time — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Recoveries
content:
The tow rate billed on the transport charge for an involuntary recovery under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract follows how long the agency needed to find the vehicle. The search time is counted in calendar days from the assignment date to the repossession date recorded on the contract, the assignment date not counted and the repossession date counted — that is, the number of days by which the repossession date falls after the assignment date.

| Search time from assignment to repossession | Tow rate |
|---|---|
| More than 14 days (the skip-trace threshold) | skip-trace rate, $185.00 |
| More than 7 days (the routine threshold) and no more than 14 days | extended-search rate, $160.00 |
| 7 days or fewer | the transport fee for the tier |
| No assignment date on record | the transport fee for the tier |

### Boundaries

| Search time | Tow rate |
|---|---|
| 7 days | the transport fee for the tier — 7 is not more than the routine threshold |
| 8 days | $160.00 |
| 14 days | $160.00 — 14 is not more than the skip-trace threshold |
| 15 days | $185.00 |

### Hypothetical dates

An account assigned on the 3rd of a month and repossessed on the 19th of the same month has a search time of 16 days and is billed at the skip-trace rate of $185.00. Assigned on the 3rd and repossessed on the 10th, the search time is 7 days and the tow is billed at the transport fee for the tier. The dates are illustrative.
